summary: Set a Storage string value atomically with quota and cross-context event semantics.

target.notes: Convert key/value to DOMString, atomically update the storage map, throw QuotaExceededError if storage cannot accept the value, and broadcast storage changes to other relevant Window objects.

caveats: Dictionary assignment misses quota, atomicity, string coercion, and storage-event behavior.

tests.name: same stored value is a no-op for broadcast
tests.expected_behavior: second write does not represent a storage-area change
